verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a root llms.txt at pipedream.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing Connect, MCP servers and API tooling. Docs pages are also served as Markdown (docs/connect/mcp.md) and point agents to a full documentation index at docs/llms.txt. Per-app Markdown pages such as apps/clickup.md and apps/openai.md give agent-ready endpoint, header and tool details. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents use these files effectively, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle.
